title: CARA: Causally Guided Retrieval Agent for Question Answering
title_zh: CARA：用于问答的因果引导检索智能体

paragraphs.en: Retrieval-augmented generation over text-rich knowledge graphs requires identifying evidence that contributes to answering a question, rather than merely matching its textual content. Existing agentic retrievers adaptively balance global search and multi-hop exploration but primarily rely on textual similarity to guide retrieval. We propose CARA, a training-free, CA usally guided R etrieval A gent that explicitly evaluates the causal relevance of retrieved evidence through two complementary criteria: consequentiality, measuring whether adding evidence improves answerability, and essentiality, assessing whether removing evidence weakens answerability. CARA integrates these assessments with path consistency to guide graph exploration and employs reciprocal rank fusion to aggregate evidence from multiple agents. We evaluate CARA on three STaRK datasets and augment STaRK with ground-truth answers to enable downstream question answering evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that CARA consistently outperforms existing retrievers. CARA also improves answer quality and faithfulness while examining fewer graph nodes and requiring fewer retrieval operations. These findings demonstrate that causal relevance assessment enables more focused and effective agentic graph retrieval, improving both retrieval performance and downstream question answering.
paragraphs.zh: 在文本丰富的知识图谱中，检索增强生成需要识别有助于回答问题的证据，而不仅仅是匹配其文本内容。 现有的智能体式检索器能够自适应地平衡全局搜索和多跳探索，但主要依赖文本相似度来指导检索。 我们提出了 CARA：一种无需训练、由因果推理引导的检索智能体，它通过两个互补的标准明确评估所检索证据的因果相关性——结果性（衡量添加证据是否提升可回答性）和必要性（衡量移除证据是否削弱可回答性）。 CARA 将这些评估与路径一致性相结合以指导图谱探索，并采用互惠排名融合来聚合来自多个智能体的证据。 我们在三个 STaRK 数据集上对 CARA 进行了评估，并通过为 STaRK 添加真实答案，使其支持下游问题回答的评估。 实验结果表明，CARA 在性能上持续优于现有的检索器。 CARA 还能提升答案的质量和忠实度，同时需要检查更少的图谱节点和更少的检索操作。 这些发现表明，因果相关性评估能够实现更具针对性和有效性的智能体式图谱检索，从而提升检索性能和下游问题回答效果。

paragraphs.en: As a promising direction in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), retrieval over text-rich knowledge graphs (KGs) rather than flat documents is increasingly used to help large language models (LLMs) answer questions and ground answers in evidence. Unlike flat document retrieval, KG retrieval must jointly exploit nodes (breadth-oriented) and traverse along relations (depth-oriented). Balancing between the search breadth and depth is a long standing challenge for KG retrieval ( Polonuer et al., 2026 ) . With the advances of agents, several recent studies ( Sun et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) delegate such tasks to retrieval agents which have autonomy to balance search breadth and depth without a pre-specified number of node searches or hops. However, these agents’ retrieval process is driven primarily by textual similarity and graph structure, which can still favor evidence that is only associated with the query but not necessary for answering it. For example, consider the question, “Which medicine should this patient avoid?” A similarity-based retriever may return a clinical note stating, “The patient currently takes several medicines, including aspirin and metformin,” because it contains many words similar to the query. However, this information does not answer the question. Another record may simply state, “Allergy: amoxicillin.” Although this short record has no textual overlap with the question, it provides the key evidence needed to answer the question. This illustrates why textual similarity alone is not enough to make a substantive contribution to the answer.
paragraphs.zh: 作为检索增强生成（RAG）领域一个充满前景的方向，从富含文本的知识图谱（KG）中进行检索，而非从扁平文档中检索，正被越来越多地用于帮助大型语言模型（LLM）回答问题并将答案与证据关联起来。 与扁平文档检索不同，知识图谱检索必须同时利用节点（广度导向）并沿关系进行遍历（深度导向）。 在搜索的广度与深度之间取得平衡，一直是知识图谱检索领域一个长期存在的挑战（Polonuer 等，2026）。 随着智能体的发展，近期的一些研究（Sun 等，2024；Yu 等，2025）将此类任务委托给检索智能体，这些智能体能够自主平衡搜索的广度与深度，而无需预先指定节点搜索次数或跳跃次数。 然而，这些智能体的检索过程主要由文本相似性和图谱结构驱动，这仍可能导致其优先选择那些仅与查询相关、但对回答问题并非必需的证据。 例如，考虑这个问题：“这位患者应避免服用哪种药物？”基于相似性的检索器可能会返回一份临床记录，其中写道：“该患者目前正在服用多种药物，包括阿司匹林和二甲双胍”，因为这段文字包含许多与查询相似的词语。 然而，这些信息并未回答该问题。 另一条记录可能仅简单陈述：“过敏：阿莫西林。”尽管这条简短的记录与问题在文本上没有任何重叠，但它提供了回答问题所需的关键证据。 这说明为何仅凭文本相似性不足以对答案产生实质性的帮助。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we design and implement a CA usally guided R etrieval A gent for question answering, named CARA , by retrieving causally relevant evidence, defined as consequential and essential evidence that is directly helpful to answer a query. After global anchoring and during neighborhood hop, the retrieval agent invokes a causal reasoning module, asking whether the current hop is consequential and essential for resolving the information need. This reasoning guides the agent’s next decision on whether to continue hopping, to re-anchor globally, or to finish when sufficient support has been found.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们设计并实现了一种通常由因果关系引导的检索智能体，用于问答任务，并将其命名为 CARA。该智能体通过检索因果相关的证据来完成任务，这些证据被定义为对回答查询直接有帮助的关键且必要的证据。 在全局锚定之后以及邻域跳跃过程中，检索智能体会调用一个因果推理模块，判断当前这一步骤对于解决信息需求是否关键且必要。 这种推理会引导智能体做出下一步决策：是继续跳跃、重新进行全局锚定，还是在找到足够支持时停止。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are threefold: (1) we formulate causal relevance as being consequential and essential, distinguishing answer-bearing evidence from merely textually similar evidence; (2) we introduce a training-free prompt-based causal reasoning module that evaluates the causal relevance from the perspectives of both the current hop and the accumulated path developed so far; and (3) we augment the well-known STaRK benchmark dataset with ground truth answers to the queries (questions), expanding its utility from only evaluating retrieval performance to evaluating both retrieval and question answering performance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献有三方面：（1）我们将因果相关性定义为具有结果导向性和必要性，从而将能够承载答案的证据与仅文本相似的证据区分开来；（2）我们引入了一种无需训练的基于提示的因果推理模块，该模块从当前跳跃和迄今为止已构建的累积路径两个角度评估因果相关性；以及（3）我们为广为人知的 STaRK 基准数据集补充了查询（问题）的真实答案，使其用途从仅评估检索性能扩展到同时评估检索和问答性能。

paragraphs.en: Recent work on retrieval-augmented generation has increasingly moved beyond flat passage retrieval toward structured knowledge, multi-hop reasoning, and autonomous search. Three lines of research are particularly relevant to our work: knowledge-graph retrieval for question answering, causal retrieval and reasoning, and agentic retrieval.

paragraphs.en: Although these approaches differ in implementation, they generally associate causality with cause-effect relations, dependency structures, or causal mechanisms represented in the underlying knowledge. Our notion is different. CARA does not require a retrieved edge or node to represent a literal cause-effect relation. Instead, we define causal relevance at retrieval time in terms of whether evidence is consequential and essential for answering the query. Thus, our focus is not causal structure in the world being described, but the causal contribution of retrieved evidence to the answering process.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on the three text-rich knowledge graphs in the well-known benchmark STaRK ( Wu et al., 2024b ) . It contains three datasets: AMAZON, MAG, and PRIME. AMAZON represents an e-commerce domain, MAG a scholarly domain, and PRIME a biomedical domain. STaRK provides natural-language queries Q Q together with ground-truth entities relevant to answer Q Q , allowing retrieval systems to be evaluated against known nodes. However, it does not provide a ground truth for evaluating generated answers. We therefore augment STaRK with ground-truth answers. For each query Q Q , we use the ground truth entities’ text attributes d V ​ ( v ) d_{V}(v) and related relations as the source information and employ Qwen3.8-27B to generate answers. We instruct the model in the prompt to satisfy four requirements: Relevance , ensuring that the answer directly addresses Q Q ; Faithfulness , ensuring that all factual claims are supported by the provided entity information; Coverage , ensuring that the names of all ground-truth entities are explicitly mentioned; and Naturalness , ensuring that the answer is fluent and natural rather than enumerating a list of retrieved entities. After answer generation, we took two extra steps to validate the answers. First, we validate the answer using an automatically calculated indicator Completeness defined as the proportion of ground-truth entities whose complete names are explicitly mentioned in the generated answer. If Completeness is below a threshold, we prompt the model to regenerate a new version of answer until it reaches the threshold. We repeat this generation-and-validation process, resulting in more complete ground truth answers. Second, we manually inspect stratified samples (approximately 10% of the generated answers) across AMAZON, MAG, and PRIME to validate that the resulting ground truth answers are appropriate across different domains and query types.

paragraphs.en: We compare CARA with conventional retrievers and agentic retrievers used in prior work. The conventional retrievers include the classic sparse retrieval, BM25 ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) ; dense embedding retrieval that rank nodes by cosine similarity, ada-002 ( OpenAI, 2022 ) and GritLM-7B ( Muennighoff et al., 2025 ) ; knowledge-aware retrieval KAR ( Xia et al., 2025 ) that conducts query expansion and applies relation type constraints during retrieval. Agentic retrievers include Think-on-Graph ( Sun et al., 2024 ) , which is a training-free LLM agent that iteratively expands paths in the graph using beam search; GraphFlow ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , which learns to generate multi-hop retrieval trajectories using GFlowNets ( Bengio et al., 2021 ) ; and ARK ( Polonuer et al., 2026 ) , which has adaptive use of global search and neighborhood exploration but without causal reasoning during graph traversal.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 CARA 与以往研究中使用的传统检索器和智能体检索器进行比较。 传统检索器包括经典的稀疏检索 BM25（Robertson 和 Zaragoza，2009）；通过余弦相似度对节点进行排序的密集嵌入检索 ada-002（OpenAI，2022）和 GritLM-7B（Muennighoff 等，2025）；以及能够执行查询扩展并在检索过程中应用关系类型约束的知识感知检索 KAR（Xia 等，2025）。 智能体检索器包括 Think-on-Graph（Sun 等，2024），这是一种无需训练的 LLM 智能体，它通过束搜索在图中迭代扩展路径；GraphFlow（Yu 等，2025），它利用 GFlowNets（Bengio 等，2021）学习生成多跳检索轨迹；以及 ARK（Polonuer 等，2026），它在图遍历过程中能够自适应地使用全局搜索和邻域探索，但缺乏因果推理能力。

paragraphs.en: We first evaluate the performance of the entity-retrieval task. We report Hit@1, Recall@20, and Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR). These metrics capture complementary aspects of retrieval performance: the proportion of a correct entity ranked first, the proportion of ground truth entities successfully retrieved among the top 20 ranked results, and how highly the first correct entity is ranked overall.

paragraphs.en: We next evaluate whether the retrieved evidence improves downstream question answering. To isolate the effect of retrieval, all retrieval systems use the same answer generator (LLM, Qwen3.8-27B), prompt, decoding configuration, and context budget. The only difference between systems is the retrieved evidence supplied to the answer generator. In this end-to-end setting, each retriever produces its own ranked evidence set, and the common generator answers the question using that evidence. To test whether better retrieval leads to better answers, we evaluate answer correctness using BERTScore ( Zhang et al., 2020 ) between the generated answer and the ground truth answer. We also evaluate answer faithfulness using the Ragas framework ( Es et al., 2024 ) , measuring whether factual claims in the generated answer are supported by the retrieved context.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们评估检索到的证据是否提升了下游的问答性能。 为了单独分析检索的影响，所有检索系统均使用相同的回答生成器（LLM，Qwen3.8-27B）、提示、解码配置和上下文预算。 各系统之间的唯一差异在于提供给回答生成器的检索证据。 在这种端到端的设置中，每个检索器都会生成自己的排序证据集，而共同的生成器则基于这些证据回答问题。 为了检验更优的检索是否能带来更好的答案，我们通过 BERTScore（Zhang et al., 2020）评估生成答案与标准答案之间的正确性。 我们还使用 Ragas 框架（Es et al., 2024）评估答案的忠实度，即衡量生成答案中的事实性陈述是否得到了检索上下文的支持。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 compares CARA ( λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 , α = 0.5 \alpha=0.5 ) with conventional and agentic retrievers on the three STaRK datasets. paragraphs.en: Table 2 evaluates the downstream question answering performance of CARA against KAR and ARK using BERTScore and the RAGAS faithfulness. CARA achieves the highest BERTScore across all three datasets, demonstrating that improved retrieval effectiveness translates into better answer quality. CARA also consistently improves faithfulness over ARK, with particularly notable gains on MAG and PRIME. Interestingly, KAR achieves the highest faithfulness across all datasets despite substantially lower BERTScore values. This suggests that generating answers closely grounded in retrieved evidence does not necessarily guarantee their correctness or completeness relative to ground-truth answers. Overall, these findings highlight the importance of evaluating both answer quality and faithfulness, and demonstrate that causal-guided retrieval improves downstream question answering while maintaining strong evidence grounding.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we proposed CARA, a training-free causally guided retrieval agent for question answering over text-rich knowledge graphs. Unlike existing agentic retrievers that primarily rely on textual similarity, CARA evaluates retrieved evidence through consequentiality and essentiality, together with path consistency, to guide graph exploration. Reciprocal rank fusion further aggregates evidence from multiple independent agents. We also augmented the STaRK benchmark with ground-truth answers to enable downstream question answering evaluation. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate that CARA consistently improves retrieval effectiveness, while also improving answer quality and faithfulness compared with ARK. Moreover, CARA achieves more focused exploration by examining fewer nodes and requiring fewer retrieval operations. However, the additional causal reasoning introduces inference latency overhead, particularly for relation-intensive questions.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 CARA——一种无需训练、基于因果推理的检索智能体，用于在文本丰富的知识图谱中回答问题。 与主要依赖文本相似性的现有智能体检索器不同，CARA 通过评估检索证据的因果相关性和必要性，并结合路径一致性，来指导图谱探索。 互惠排名融合进一步整合了来自多个独立智能体的证据。 我们还为 STaRK 基准测试补充了真实答案，以便进行下游的问题回答评估。 在三个数据集上进行的实验表明，与 ARK 相比，CARA 能够持续提升检索效果，同时改善答案的质量和忠实度。 此外，CARA 通过检查更少的节点和减少检索操作，实现了更具针对性的探索。 然而，额外的因果推理会引入推理延迟开销，尤其是在处理关系密集型问题时。

paragraphs.en: Despite its promising results, CARA has several limitations. First, causal relevance is operationalized through LLM-based assessments of consequentiality and essentiality rather than formal inference. These assessments may be sensitive to model biases, prompting strategies, and errors in evaluating evidence contributions. Second, although CARA reduces retrieval operations and examined nodes, the additional causal reasoning module increases computational overhead and inference latency, particularly for relation-intensive questions. Third, downstream question answering evaluation relies on automatically constructed ground-truth answers and LLM-based faithfulness assessments, which may introduce evaluation noise. Future work will explore more efficient causal assessments and alternative evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 CARA 取得了令人鼓舞的结果，但它仍然存在一些局限性。 首先，因果相关性是通过基于大语言模型（LLM）的后果性和必要性评估来操作的，而非通过形式化推理。 这些评估可能对模型偏见、提示策略以及证据贡献评估中的错误较为敏感。 其次，尽管 CARA 减少了检索操作和需要检查的节点，但其新增的因果推理模块却增加了计算开销和推理延迟，尤其是在处理关系密集型问题时。 第三，下游问答评估依赖于自动构建的真实答案和基于大语言模型（LLM）的忠实度评估，这可能会引入评估噪声。 未来的工作将探索更高效的因果评估方法和替代性评估方案。
